text:
maria: quick sync - product wants a per-model unit-econ breakdown in the econ dashboard. they want tokens, cache savings, and estimated $ cost per model. primary ask: how to compute estimated $ without leaking pricing details.

 dan: we can show relative cost score (1-100) instead of dollars. but customer billing team needs dollar estimates for recon. maybe internal toggle that reveals $ only in export.

kevin: telemetry complexity: model attribution for multi-model chains isn't trivial. we currently attribute tokens to the last model called. that undercounts intermediary reranker / embedder usage. need clarity on attribution rules.

sofia: proposal: two tabs in the model view: "Attribution (last model)" and "Attribution (chain-proportional)". chain-proportional uses token shares per call and normalizes by chain length; more expensive but more accurate. default to last-model for performance.

maria: UX: product prefers a single view initially to avoid confusion. suggest exposing the two attribution modes in an advanced dropdown. default to last-model but show a banner "For chains, switch to chain-proportional for detailed billing exports."

lee: infra-bot shows nightly job: model-chain-attribution backfill running. infra-bot: job succeeded (runbook #445).

maria: API question: internal GET /v1/econ/models_summary returns a list of { model_id, tokens }. can we add model_cost_score and cache_savings_est as optional fields?

kevin: yes, but mark them optional. computing cache_savings_est relies on the cache_credit view which is sample-limited. include sample_rate metadata.

sofia: for export we can provide dollars by multiplying token counts by model_sku_unit_cost from pricing table (internal only). to avoid leaks, UI will show score; export fills in dollars for billing roles only.

maria: rollout: feature flag gated, canary to internal + two enterprise customers. monitor: differences between score-based ranking and $ ranking, support tickets mentioning unexpected model costs. also watch the response size of /v1/econ/models_summary.

dan: action items: (1) kevin to add model attribution modes and a flag in pipeline, (2) sofia to add model_cost_score & cache_savings_est to internal API schema (nullable), (3) maria to design banner + advanced dropdown copy, (4) lee to ensure backfills complete for 90d history.

infra-bot: deploy:feature-flag-create completed (#ff-331).

maria: thanks. one more: can we add a small percentile filter for "top 10 models by token burn" to keep the table manageable? product likes that.

kevin: doable. we'll add server-side pagination and a top-k param.

maria: great. wrapping up.
